parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the stream belongs. The template takes effect only if the AppName value matches the AppName in the ingest URL. The value is case-sensitive.

parameters.name: BizType
parameters.description: The business type. This parameter can be used to select a model. Default value: the domain name.

parameters.name: OssBucket
parameters.description: The name of the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.

parameters.name: OssEndpoint
parameters.description: The name of the OSS endpoint.

parameters.name: OssObject
parameters.description: The name of the recording stored in OSS.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The stream name. The template takes effect only if the StreamName value matches the StreamName in the ingest URL. The value is case-sensitive.
